settings.content:
Curative supports the introduction and development of selected professional skincare brands and product ranges in Asian markets. Depending on the brand and market, this may include:

  • Product and range planning
  • Local product access and commercial support
  • Clinic onboarding
  • Product education and team training
  • Clinic-to-home routine development
  • Patient and customer education materials
  • Launch and campaign support
  • Professional and product enquiries

Availability and support services may differ by country, brand and product classification.

Our work begins with practical needs rather than catalogue size. For clinics, this can mean selecting a focused starter portfolio around pigmentation, oily or blemish-prone skin, visible ageing, sensitivity or procedure recovery. For consumers, it means providing a clearer path from a skin concern to suitable product information and professional advice.

Curative works with appropriate professional partners, which may include aesthetic clinics, dermatology practices, medical spas, skin centres and procedure-based practices. Our aim is to help partners understand how products fit into professional services, maintenance programmes and home-care recommendations. Any professional protocol must follow current manufacturer guidance, local requirements and the practitioner’s own assessment.

C-Aesthetics gives customers access to clearer product explanations, concern-based navigation and routine education. It does not attempt to replace an individual consultation or diagnose a skin condition. Where a product requires professional supervision, this should be stated clearly. Where a concern is persistent, severe or medically diagnosed, customers should seek advice from an appropriately qualified professional.

settings.col_1_text: Explain the product’s purpose, suitability, use and limitations in language customers can understand.
settings.col_2_text: Base published information on current manufacturer materials, registered labels and appropriately reviewed evidence.

settings.col_1_text: Connect clinic care with sensible home-care support where this is appropriate.
settings.col_2_text: Consider the practical concerns associated with Asian climates and lifestyles, including year-round ultraviolet exposure, heat, humidity, air-conditioning and frequent aesthetic procedures—without suggesting that all Asian skin behaves in the same way.

settings.content:
Responsible access

Maintain clear boundaries around professional-use products and avoid encouraging unsafe or unsupervised use.
Speak with our team about product information, clinic supply, professional education and partnership opportunities.

settings.label: Information required before publication
settings.content: Add the following only after Curative confirms the official details: registered business address, company registration number, general contact email, professional enquiry email, telephone or WhatsApp number, operating hours, supported countries, and official distribution statements for each brand.

settings.heading: The company behind C-Aesthetics
settings.intro: C-Aesthetics is managed by Curative Pte Ltd, a Singapore-based company supporting access to specialised skincare, aesthetic products and professional solutions. We work at the point where product selection, professional education and commercial support meet. Through C-Aesthetics, we make concern-led skincare easier to discover online while preserving the distinction between everyday home care and products intended for qualified practitioners.
